keyword: trader joe's eligible shoppers can claim class action settlement money
claims: Trader Joe's shoppers who used a credit or debit card between March 5, 2019, and July 19, 2019, and received a receipt showing the first six and last four digits of the card number can claim a share of a $7.4 million settlement.
The estimated payout is approximately $102.45 per claimant.
Claims must be submitted by June 9, 2026.
Purchases qualifying for eligibility occurred at a Trader Joe's store between March 5, 2019, and July 19, 2019.
Eligibility requires using a credit or debit card.
Eligibility requires receiving a receipt displaying the first six and last four digits of the card number.
The $7.4 million settlement compensates shoppers for potential violations of the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act (FACTA).
FACTA restricts printing excessive card information.
The official settlement website is www.TJ-FACTASettlement.com.
Claims can be filed by calling 1-888-444-7415.
A Class ID number is required.
A final approval hearing for the settlement is scheduled for August 10, 2026.
If approved, checks are expected to be sent within 10 business days following the approval date.
